$comment: Class rift interaction fixture (#199). NOT CONTENT: it lives outside content/ so neither the loader nor content:validate ever sees it, and nothing ships it. Its chapter ids are placeholders with no files behind them. One mandatory goal - getting through the sealed rift to the far shore - that every party composition can reach its own way: a Starweaver senses the rift, studies at the star tower, attunes to it and later weaves it toward Starfall Glade (a progression earned through the campaign, kept as the world fact `attunement`); a Thornguard forces the seal (and leaves it torn: the far shore plays a harder chapter; and the party strained: a Guard -1 burden buff for the next fight); a Songkeeper sings it calm; a Duskrunner scouts a hidden shadow path; anyone carrying a Mosslight Jar holds it to the seal; and a party with none of them befriends the hermit, who opens it for them - the ungated way the lint (CLASS_GATED_ONLY_PATH) requires. class-rifts.test.ts walks it; packages/server/src/handlers/class-rifts.test.ts plays it through the server; docs/campaigns/graph-campaigns.md (Class rift interaction) walks through it.
title: The Sealed Rift
blurb: A camp, a star tower, a hermit's hut and a rift sealed shut. Every party gets through its own way. Not a story: a map of class rift interaction.

seal-strain.$comment: The Thornguard's cost (#199 with #200): forcing the seal leaves the party bruised - Guard -1 in the next fight, gone after one fight or a rest. A burden is a buff with a negative amount.
seal-strain.label: Seal Strain

attunement.$comment: The Starweaver's progression: sense (+1), study at the star tower (+1), attune (needs 2, gives +1), weave (needs 3). Journey state, so it is stored with the attempt and is there next evening.
attunement.label: Rift attunement

observatory.$comment: Played once (closed). Studying the stars raises the party's attunement - the campaign-earned half of the Starweaver's progression, open to every party (only a Starweaver can use it).
observatory.title: The Star Tower

hermit-hut.$comment: The NPC fallback: finishing the hermit's chapter makes them a friend, and a friend opens the seal for any party.
hermit-hut.title: The Hermit's Hut

far-shore.$comment: The goal. Forced open by a Thornguard, the veil is torn and the far shore plays its harder chapter.
far-shore.title: The Far Shore

veil-rift.$comment: Sealed: asleep until someone has stood on the far side (which only the shadow path allows), so from here only an action opens it. Every open way changes the rift the same way; who can take each, and what else it does, differs.
veil-rift.label: The shimmering seal

open.label: Attune to the rift and open it
open.hint: A Starweaver who has studied the stars could open this.

open.label: Sing the seal calm until it parts
Hold the Mosslight Jar to the seal
open.hint: Something that glows like moss might wake this seal.

open.label: Ask the hermit to open the seal

redirect.label: Weave the rift toward the falling stars

shadow-path.$comment: Hidden (blocked hidden) and asleep: a Duskrunner scouts it out, and their scouting opens it.
shadow-path.label: A narrow shadow path

discover.label: Scout the cliffs for another way
